subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A T-shirt is not only clothing.”?
options: The noise map showed that what people hear also needs planning.
It is a map of global choices.
Having fun is good, but choices still matter.
Saving seeds was also saving choices for tomorrow's meals.

本文可直接核對「A T-shirt is not only clothing. It is a map of global choices.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
